raw_segments.text: Telemachus, what are you talking about?
Heaven has a long arm if it is minded to save a man,
and if it were me, I should not care how much I suffered before getting home,
provided I could be safe when I was once there.
I would rather this than get home quickly,
and then be killed in my own house as Agamemnon was by the treachery of Agisthus and his wife.
Still, death is certain, and when a man's hour is come,
not even the gods can save him, no matter how fond they are of him.
